description: Filter ACCRUE vaults by chain, risk tier, protocol, and/or minimum APY. Returns the matching vaults with live APY data. Use this when the user wants to narrow down by criteria like "Base vaults only", "highest yield on Arbitrum", or "show me conservative options above 4%".

min_apy_pct.description: Minimum effective APY in percent (e.g. 4 for 4%).

name: search_vaults
